title: The Diary of a CEO × Tara Swart — 老板的压力，助理的腰围
title_en: The Diary of a CEO × Tara Swart — The Boss's Stress, the Assistant's Waistline

questions.question: Tara Swart 说领导的压力会像性激素一样经汗液「漏」进下属的皮肤。按节目页的核查，证据实际支持的是哪种说法？
options: 压力经汗液传播已被证实，只是传染强度比她说的小一些
压力传染本身就是迷思，观察别人受压并不会改变观察者的皮质醇
压力传染和月经同步一样，都是已被证实的激素经皮肤在人与人之间传递的现象
压力传染确有其事，但已知通道是看见别人受压，经汗液传播找不到研究
questions.explanation: Engert 等人的研究里，隔着单向镜看别人受压的观察者有 26% 皮质醇显著升高，所以传染是真的，但通道是眼睛。她用来类比的月经同步本身就没被复现，皮质醇随汗液进入他人身体则找不到任何研究。
questions.question_en: Tara Swart claims a leader's stress "leaks" through sweat into subordinates' skin, like sex hormones. Per the page's fact-check, what does the evidence actually support?
options_en: Transmission through sweat is established; the effect is just smaller than she suggests
Stress contagion is a myth; watching others under stress doesn't change the observer's cortisol
Like menstrual synchrony, it is a confirmed case of hormones passing from person to person through the skin
Stress contagion is real, but the known channel is seeing others stressed; no study shows transfer via sweat
questions.explanation_en: In Engert et al., 26% of people watching others get stressed through a one-way mirror showed a significant cortisol rise, so contagion is real but travels through the eyes. Her analogy, menstrual synchrony, failed to replicate, and no study was found showing cortisol entering others through sweat.

questions.question: Swart 说「只是坐着想象举重，肌肉量就增加了 13%」。与这个数字吻合的研究实际说明了什么？
options: 想象训练能增加肌肉量，只是需要 12 周而不是两周
这个数字来自一项无法复现的实验，想象训练对身体没有任何可测效果
想象训练和实际训练效果相当，所以完全可以用来替代真正去健身房的力量训练
想象训练提高的是力量，作者归因于大脑驱动信号变强，没测出肌肉变大
questions.explanation: Ranganathan 等人 2004 年的研究测的是力量而不是肌肉量，想象组涨幅也明显小于真练组，作者认为是大脑调动肌肉的信号变强。想象能练出更会调动肌肉的大脑，但没有证据说能练出肌肉。
questions.question_en: Swart says people who merely imagined lifting weights gained 13% muscle. What does the study matching that figure actually show?
options_en: Imagery does build muscle mass, it just takes 12 weeks rather than two
The figure comes from an experiment that failed to replicate; imagery has no measurable physical effect
Imagined training works as well as real training, so it can fully replace actually lifting at the gym
Imagery raised strength, credited to stronger neural drive; no growth in muscle size was measured
questions.explanation_en: Ranganathan et al. (2004) measured strength, not muscle mass, and the imagery group gained clearly less than those who actually trained; the authors attributed the gain to stronger signals from the brain. Imagery trains a brain better at recruiting muscle, not bigger muscles.

questions.question: 「只要还在往外漏皮质醇，少吃多动都减不掉肚子」——按核查，这句话的问题在哪？
options: 皮质醇确实决定了腹部脂肪的多少，只是必须靠严格节食而不是靠运动才能减下来
说法基本属实，只有长期高强度运动才能抵消皮质醇的作用
两者只有弱的横断面相关、因果方向不明，而单做有氧 12 周就能减内脏脂肪
皮质醇与腰围毫无关联，压力和腹部脂肪之间不存在任何联系
questions.explanation: 头发皮质醇和腰围确有关联，但相关系数只有 0.1 到 0.2，数据是横断面的，甚至可能是腹部肥胖反过来改变了压力轴。「运动减不掉」则说反了：汇总试验显示不节食、只做有氧 12 周就能减少内脏脂肪。
questions.question_en: "As long as you're leaking cortisol, no diet or exercise will shift belly fat" — according to the fact-check, what's wrong with this?
options_en: Cortisol really does control belly fat, but it can only be reduced through strict dieting, not through exercise
It's basically true; only prolonged high-intensity exercise can offset cortisol's effect
The link is weak, cross-sectional and of unclear direction, and aerobic exercise alone cuts visceral fat in 12 weeks
Cortisol and waist size are completely unrelated; stress has nothing to do with abdominal fat
questions.explanation_en: Hair cortisol does correlate with waist size, but only at 0.1–0.2, in cross-sectional data, and abdominal obesity may even be altering the stress axis rather than the reverse. "Exercise won't work" is backwards: pooled trials show aerobic exercise without dieting reduces visceral fat within 12 weeks.
